findings.title: Attribution change lacks security sign-off
findings.problem: security-practices.md (CRITICAL: Project & User Attribution Headers, rules 1-2) requires sign-off for attribution derivation changes. The end metric sessionId changes to session.startMetricSessionId || agentSessionId, metrics-aggregator.ts puts the same field first, and no commit body or task-folder file records a CRITICAL callout or sign-off. The PR itself states sign-off is required before merge.
findings.impact: The guide and the git-workflow.md checklist gate merge on this, and a wrong session_id can break server-side correlation of start, end and delta metrics. Whether a metric body session_id is in scope is a reading of the guide's catch-all clause, and a sign-off held outside the repository would satisfy it.
findings.recommendation: Call the change out as CRITICAL in the PR description and record security-review sign-off with the reviewer checklist, or record in the PR why the metric session_id is outside the attribution scope.
